view.scene_description: The image depicts the interior of a warehouse or storage facility. The space is filled with tall metal shelving units on both sides, reaching up to the ceiling. These shelves are stocked with various items, including red plastic bins and cardboard boxes in different colors such as yellow, green, and brown. The floor is gray concrete, and there's a bright light source at the end of the aisle, creating a contrast between the illuminated area and the darker surroundings. On the right side of the aisle, there's an orange forklift parked near some wooden pallets. A yellow and black striped caution sign is visible on the left side of the aisle, likely indicating a hazard or restricted area. The overall atmosphere suggests an industrial setting where goods are stored and organized for distribution or inventory management.

objects.observation: tall metal shelving unit on the left side of the aisle, filled with various items like red plastic bins and cardboard boxes in different colors such as yellow, green, and brown. The shelves reach up to the ceiling and support the weight of the stored items. The unit appears sturdy and well-constructed, designed for heavy-duty use in a warehouse environment.

objects.label: red plastic bins
objects.observation: several red plastic bins are stacked on the shelves, each labeled 'HYDAC'. They appear to be uniform in size and shape, suggesting they are used for storing similar items. The bins are neatly arranged, indicating an organized storage system within the warehouse.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: various cardboard boxes in different colors such as yellow, green, and brown are also stored on the shelves. These boxes vary in size and shape, possibly containing different types of products or materials. Some boxes have visible labels or markings, while others do not, indicating a diverse range of contents.

objects.label: gray concrete floor
objects.observation: the floor is made of gray concrete, providing a durable and easy-to-clean surface suitable for an industrial setting. It appears clean and well-maintained, with no visible debris or damage.

objects.label: bright light source at the end of the aisle
objects.observation: a bright light source is visible at the end of the aisle, creating a contrast between the illuminated area and the darker surroundings. This light source could be a skylight or an overhead fixture, providing natural or artificial illumination to the warehouse space.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: an orange forklift is parked near some wooden pallets on the right side of the aisle. The forklift has a black handlebar and is equipped with a red seat. Its presence indicates that this warehouse is actively used for loading and unloading goods.

objects.label: yellow and black striped caution sign
objects.observation: a yellow and black striped caution sign is visible on the left side of the aisle. The sign features diagonal stripes and is positioned near the edge of the aisle, likely serving as a warning or safety indicator for workers in the warehouse.

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33088", "image_size": [640, 480], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
